Application, content and launch artifacts remain separate; exact compatibility is pre-approved; updates and rollbacks affect only later processes; one authority loss ends only its Training Session; and replacement always creates a new Training Session.

`Resolved; project-owner amendment confirmed`. Confirmed connection loss and explicit departure during active simulation both cause one irreversible Technical Removal with cause `Disconnected`; the Admission ends, associated items become `Withdrawn`, the removed Trainee cannot act or rejoin, and the simulation continues. The outcome is not Fatal, injury, incapacity, casualty or task error, and each Scenario deterministically governs the result when a Team becomes empty.

Retained evidence is indefinite in the initial baseline and is not a resumable checkpoint.
